theme: soft-fail plate lifecycle: READ OR + COPY/RENAME/RM staging→live→archive

tests.name: second_promote_archives
tests.cmd: new staging v2 over existing live; run -q -s
tests.note: archive/LIVE.bak holds v1; live is v2

tests.name: staging_missing_exit_2
tests.note: expected EXIT 2 staging missing; READ OR soft then EXIT

tests.name: copy_miss_strict_sticky
tests.cmd: SYS COPY missing src; PASS; no CLEAR_ERR; run -q -s
tests.note: last_err copy: missing source; err_line=0; rc=1

weaknesses.title: EXPECT rewrites OK — cannot test prior soft result after EXPECT
weaknesses.detail: SYS RM live_dir soft-fails (OK=0). EXPECT OK == 0 then sets OK=1 on pass. A following IF OK == 1 was misread as 'RM succeeded and deleted the directory', causing EXIT 3 on a healthy promote. Agents must LET snap = OK before any EXPECT/ASSERT that consumes OK. Overloading OK for soft host ops + soft checks is a real footgun.
weaknesses.repro: SYS RM dir; EXPECT OK == 0; IF OK == 1 THEN … — OK is expect-pass, not RM success

weaknesses.title: COPY/RM soft failures still err_line=0 empty err_src
weaknesses.detail: copy: missing source and mkdir/rm dir soft errs leave last_err text but no line attribution. run -s fails after PASS without CLEAR_ERR with no jump-to-source. Same class as SIZE/WRITE/SERVE plates.

weaknesses.title: No versioned archive rotation without LISTDIR
weaknesses.detail: Promote overwrites a single LIVE.bak. Cannot enumerate archive/* or generate unique archive names with time+seq without shell. DATE is available but multi-CAT into filenames is awkward; no LISTDIR to prune old baks.
weaknesses.repro: third promote still only one .bak file

weaknesses.title: SYS JOIN still not in forms/search
weaknesses.detail: Lifecycle worker depends on JOIN for every path; forms JOIN remains n=0 (iters 7–8). READ OR/COPY/RM are catalogued; JOIN still invisible.

weaknesses.title: Cannot easily build archive names from STEM+DATE+EXT
weaknesses.detail: Want LIVE-2026….bak from STEM + DATE + EXT requires nested CAT and careful dots; no path format helper. Program uses fixed LIVE.bak via CAT stem ".bak" only.
weaknesses.repro: see archive naming block in plate_promote.cubalc

weaknesses.title: RENAME across dirs may fail silently into COPY fallback — good, but mode opacity
weaknesses.detail: When MODE=rename fails, program CLEARs and copies; agents reading only MODE env may think rename was used. No RENAME_OK distinct sticky beyond OK/LAST_ERR timing.
weaknesses.repro: cross-device rename miss path (if any) falls back without plate field

workarounds: LET snap = OK immediately after soft host ops before EXPECT/ASSERT/PASS
CLEAR_ERR after intentional soft COPY/RM/READ OR when using run -s
Fixed .bak name or host-side versioned archive dir until LISTDIR
Hardcode SYS JOIN; watch MEANINGFUL_ITER for catalog fix
Prefer MODE=copy for promote (default) when rename semantics are unclear
SYS ISDIR after RM-dir probe to prove directory survival
language_gaps: Separate soft-result vars that EXPECT does not clobber (or EXPECT leaves OK alone)
err_line/err_src on COPY/RM/RENAME/READ OR soft fails
Path format / multi-part CAT for STEM-DATE-EXT names
Plate field rename_ok / copy_n already partially there — expose on run plate
